headline: 218 commits today
prose:
**Mon 19 Oct** — GSS Stats gained a Play-direct arm with per-campaign Play installs, then spent the day fixing its ads reporting; Best Sudoku's CI notification step got patience. `[REDACTED]` logged 124 commits, mostly docs and untagged work.

**Sun 18 Oct** — Best Sudoku landed Apple in-app purchases end to end, a large-screen menu layout and an ASC screenshot uploader, and shipped two releases. Agent Templates added Windows CI coverage. `[REDACTED]` added 49 commits, a quarter of them fixes.

**Sat 17 Oct** — Best Sudoku spent 137 commits mostly making the E2E suite cheaper and harder to wedge, then closed out a release. GSS Stats added Flight 3 reporting cards.

**Fri 16 Oct** — Best Sudoku got Sign in with Apple through sign-in, account linking and token revocation, plus a build-channel guard. GSS Stats added feature-health reporting and activated flight 3. `[REDACTED]` made one chore commit.

**Thu 15 Oct** — StarRupture plugins now ship update notes in their release manifests, and BetterCheats gained a pause-menu row. GSS Stats staged flight 3 and added view-only access. `[REDACTED]` made one chore commit.
